page.overview:
Who is Tarannon Falastur?

Tarannon "Falastur" was the twelfth King of Gondor.

Tarannon succeeded his father Siriondil in TA 830. His brother was Tarciryan. He started the construction of Gondor's navies, and became known as the first of the Ship-kings. Under his policies and successful rule, Gondor's extended its power to the west and south of the Mouths of Anduin. He, along with Narmacil I, was one of two childless Kings of Gondor, making him a break-point in the bloodline. Nevertheless his rule was marked by such vigorous naval expansion that at his coronation he assumed the additional [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regnal_name regnal name] of Falastur, meaning 'Lord of the Coasts'.

The king particularly favored the city of Pelargir, constructing a palace there built out over the Anduin river on arches.

Despite his successes, his reign was troubled by the intrigues of his own wife Queen Berúthiel who spied on everyone within the kingdom. Eventually, he grew tired of her acts, exiling her and her cats to the south. As a result of his wife's exile, he died childless in TA 913, and was succeeded by his nephew Eärnil I.
